UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Minimal authenticated teacher account anchor document (no PII stored) used to scope per-account data.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication UID of the teacher account.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account record was initialized.

CustomHoliday.title: CustomHoliday
CustomHoliday.description: A custom non-working / school holiday date recorded strictly for a specific authenticated teacher account.

userId.description: Owner teacher Firebase Auth UID matching request.auth.uid.

title.description: Khmer or display title/reason for the custom holiday.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when this custom holiday entry was created.

UserGradebook.title: UserGradebook
UserGradebook.description: Auto-saved classroom gradebook state (settings, roster, attendance, monthly scores, semester scores, domain grades, remarks, and linked Google Sheet info) owned by a teacher account.

userId.description: Owner teacher Firebase Auth UID matching request.auth.uid.

settings.description: Class settings map including class name, academic year, active periods, semester months, and per-account customSubjectLabels / customSemesterSubjectLabels / hiddenMonthlySubjectKeys / hiddenSemesterSubjectKeys.

attendanceByMonth.description: Monthly attendance records indexed by YYYY-MM.

attendanceReasonsByMonth.description: Monthly excused-leave ('ច្ប') reasons indexed by YYYY-MM -> studentId -> day.

monthlyScoresByMonth.description: Monthly subject scores indexed by YYYY-MM.

competencyRubricsByMonth.description: Monthly indicator rubric evaluations for បំណិនសម្បទា and ចរិយាសម្បទា indexed by YYYY-MM -> studentId.

semesterScoresByTerm.description: Semester exam scores indexed by semester number string.

competencyRubricsByTerm.description: Semester indicator rubric evaluations for បំណិនសម្បទា and ចរិយាសម្បទា indexed by semester term string -> studentId.

domainGradesByTerm.description: Semester evaluation domain grades indexed by semester number string.

remarks.description: Teacher remarks keyed by student ID.

activeSheet.description: Linked Google Spreadsheet metadata or null if not yet created.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the gradebook record was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the gradebook record was last auto-saved.

/users/{userId}.description: Per-teacher account root document anchored to Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/customHolidays/{holidayI.description: Per-teacher custom off-days and school holidays, isolated per logged-in account.

/users/{userId}/gradebooks/{gradebookId}.description: Auto-saved per-teacher class gradebook (students, attendance, monthly/semester scores, remarks, settings).
